build: ( : -p mason-conformance --lib --bins; cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-conformance --lib --bins --no-run ) && ( : -p mason-conformance; cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-conformance --no-run ) && ( : -p mason-daemon --test it; cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-daemon --test it --no-run )
command: mason_rc=0; ( : -p mason-conformance --lib --bins; RUSTDOC="$PWD/scripts/rustdoc-bootstrap.sh" cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-conformance --lib --bins --config 'target."cfg(unix)".runner=["env","RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1"]' -- -Z unstable-options --report-time ) || mason_rc=1; ( : -p mason-conformance --doc; RUSTDOC="$PWD/scripts/rustdoc-bootstrap.sh" cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-conformance --doc --config 'target."cfg(unix)".runner=["env","RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1"]' -- -Z unstable-options --report-time ) || mason_rc=1; ( : -p mason-daemon --test it; RUSTDOC="$PWD/scripts/rustdoc-bootstrap.sh" cargo test --no-fail-fast --target-dir $HOME/.cache/mason-target/$(basename "$PWD") -p mason-daemon --test it --config 'target."cfg(unix)".runner=["env","RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1"]' -- -Z unstable-options --report-time plugin_adapters:: protocol:: ) || mason_rc=1; [ $mason_rc -eq 0 ]
